description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'MandatoryModuleException' used in the OpenMRS framework, indicating errors related to mandatory modules that fail to start or cannot be stopped. The class extends 'ModuleMustStartException' and provides constructors for various scenarios involving mandatory modules.

classes.name: MandatoryModuleException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a mandatory module in OpenMRS cannot be started or is attempted to be stopped. It can be constructed with a single module ID, a module ID with extra message, or a list of module IDs.

methods.name: MandatoryModuleException(String moduleId)
methods.description: Constructor used when a user tries to stop a mandatory module identified by its moduleId.

methods.name: MandatoryModuleException(String moduleId, String extraErrorMessage)
methods.description: Constructor used when a user tries to stop a mandatory module, with an additional error message.

methods.name: MandatoryModuleException(List<String> moduleIds)
methods.description: Constructor used when multiple mandatory modules failed to start.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Returns the ID(s) of the module(s) that caused this exception.
